description: This file implements the Http2PriorityDependencies class, managing HTTP/2 stream priority dependencies, including stream creation, updates, and destruction within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: Http2PriorityDependencies
classes.description: Manages HTTP/2 stream priority dependencies, including creation, updates, and parent/child relationships.

methods.name: OnStreamCreation
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new stream, assigning priority and parent stream based on existing dependencies.

methods.name: PriorityLowerBound
methods.description: Finds the lowest priority list with streams at or above a given priority.

methods.name: ParentOfStream
methods.description: Determines the parent stream of a given stream based on priority dependencies.

methods.name: ChildOfStream
methods.description: Finds the child stream of a given stream based on priority dependencies.

methods.name: OnStreamUpdate
methods.description: Updates the priority of a stream and adjusts dependencies accordingly.

methods.name: OnStreamDestruction
methods.description: Removes a stream from dependency management upon destruction.
